description: An \(L\)-structure satisfies \(\neg\operatorname{Inf}\) exactly when its domain is finite.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.not_infinitySentence_realize.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (M : Type w) [L.Structure M] :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Sentence.Realize
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.neg
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.infinitySentence L))
      M ↔
    Finite M
